site_description: Reach your savings goals week by week. Create an account and start saving with support and clarity.
hero_title: Reach your goals week by week
hero_subtitle: Saving money doesn't have to be hard. I give you the support and control you need to hit your goal more easily.
hero_trusted: Built for people who actually want to save
features_title: Everything you need to hit your target
feature_goals_body: Set your target amount and see how much to save each week or month to get there on time.
feature_safe_body: Sign in with Google or Facebook and track progress in an app built for everyday use.
feature_progress_body: Follow deposits, history, and how much is left before each goal is complete.
feature_reminders_body: Get nudges so you stay on track and keep the 52-week discipline going.
feature_multi_body: Trip, laptop, emergency fund — create as many goals as you want and track each one.
feature_control_body: Adjust deadlines, see live projections, and choose weekly or monthly saving.
how_1_body: Sign in in seconds with Google or Facebook and unlock the app.
how_2_body: Choose the amount, currency, and deadline. We calculate how much to save each period.
how_3_body: Log deposits, get reminders, and watch your progress until you hit the goal.
review_1_body: Finally an app that helps me save consistently. In a few weeks I already saw progress toward my trip goal.
review_2_body: Weekly reminders make all the difference. I stay on pace without losing track of my plan.
review_3_body: Simple, clear, and direct. I set two goals and now know exactly how much to save each month.
faq_subtitle: Quick answers about the 52 Week Challenge and how to start saving with the app.
faq_1_a: It's an app that helps you reach financial goals with a weekly or monthly savings plan, reminders, and progress tracking.
faq_2_q: How do I create an account?
faq_2_a: Click Create account and sign in with Google or Facebook. Your account is created automatically on first login.
faq_3_a: Yes. You can create goals and track your savings at no cost to get started.
faq_4_q: Do I need to connect my bank?
faq_4_a: No. You log deposits yourself and keep control of what you've already saved.
faq_5_q: Can I have more than one goal?
faq_5_a: Yes. Create as many goals as you want and track each one with its own savings plan.
cta_body: Create your account in minutes and turn weekly saving into real progress toward your goal.
footer_blurb: Save with clarity. Plan your goals week by week and follow every step to the finish line.
terms_description: Terms and conditions of use for the 52 Week Challenge.

terms_2_body: This app helps you set savings goals and track weekly or monthly deposits. It provides reminders and progress tracking. It is not a bank, financial advisor, or payment processor.
terms_3_body: You sign in through third-party identity providers (Google, Facebook) via AWS Cognito. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials on those platforms.
terms_4_body: We store your goals, deposit history, and preferences to provide the service. Data is synced between your device, Cloudflare KV cache, and D1 database. We do not sell your personal data.
terms_5_body: You may receive email and push notifications about savings reminders and milestones. You can manage notifications in the app.
terms_6_body: Savings projections are estimates only. Actual results depend on your behavior. We make no guarantee that you will reach any financial goal.
terms_7_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the app.
terms_8_body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.
